what: When creating a product on Gumroad, sellers choose from product types that include Digital product, Course or tutorial, and E-book (one-time payment with digital content), as well as recurring charge memberships, physical goods, bundles of multiple existing products, and service-type products. Products can be priced from free up to USD 5,000, with pay-what-you-want pricing supported via a "+" notation on the minimum price.
verbatim_snippet: "Digital product, Course or tutorial, and E-book type products allow you to sell one-time payment products with digital content in it. You can also sell recurring charge memberships, physical goods that you ship, a bundle of multiple existing products, and service-type products. Products can be free or as much as USD 5,000. You can also let customers pay whatever they want by adding a '+' to a product's minimum price, like "$5+"."
